rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 33:24 hāʿām hayyōšēḇ bāh nᵉśuʾ ʿāwōn 'the people who dwell in it shall be forgiven their iniquity' (ASV, JPS 1917; NJPS 'whose sin has been forgiven'; checked 2026-11-26) is the forgiveness sense (a) of the formula in the passive participle, 'lifted of iniquity' (cf. Ps 32:1 nᵉśûy-pešaʿ).
isaiah-woh wave I-5: 'iniquity' at Isa 33:24 (nᵉśuʾ ʿāwōn).

isaiah-woh wave I-5: 'dwell' at Isa 33:5 (YHWH šōḵēn mārôm 'dwells on high') and 33:16 (the righteous person mᵉrômîm yiškōn 'shall dwell on high'), the chapter setting the two dwellings side by side; gûr at 33:14 and the noun šāḵēn 'inhabitant' at 33:24 are not governed by this entry.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 33:5 mišpāṭ ûṣᵉḏāqāh 'justice and righteousness', the joined pair in the order of Isa 9:6, rendered in the Hebrew order.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: 'land' at Isa 33:9 ('the land mourns and languishes', Judah) and 33:17 (ʾereṣ marḥaqqîm 'a land that stretches afar').

isaiah-woh wave I-5: plural yᵉʾōrîm beside nᵉhārîm at Isa 33:21 is 'streams' under the Isaiah context clause ('a place of broad rivers and streams', ASV and JPS 1917; NJPS 'broad streams'; checked 2026-11-26).
